_about: NPC blurbs and quotes for the Bartok's Trading Post Dimguil walkthrough, chapter by chapter. Chapters follow harano's walkthrough on dra.jp (https://dra.jp/game/wizardy-dimguil/chart/<harano>.html) in his index order; his moving-floor chapter (13) says it is played after Area D's release. Each entry: who appears, the strings involved, how the placement is known (Walkthrough, Game, Inferred), a 1-3 sentence blurb, and quotes in the patch's English, each pinned to its file and string. Quotes are checked with scripts/wtquotes.py check; docs/walkthrough-quotes.md is the readable ledger. `flags` notes things to settle in the patch (unreviewed or doubtful lines). `source` is the agent file the entry came from.
